source.operation: single scalar ASCII reading or error-queue response
source.transport: offline saved bytes; no transport driver included

data.raw_provenance: Synthetic fixture following the manual's documented ASCII example; not a real instrument capture.

known_limitations: No instrument transport or hardware verification is included.
The parser accepts one ASCII scalar line and one error-queue line only.
Multi-reading, binary, and scanner responses are unsupported.
Calibration, fuse continuity, and acquisition freshness are not inferred.
